title: Question 1: Evidence for the domestic end product test
body:
**What is asked.** Which cost records should evidence the component-cost test of 48 CFR 25.101(a), and for power inverters eligibility under 26 U.S.C. 45X. How supplier cost data a manufacturer cannot compel should be handled. How the computation can be verified while cost data stays confidential.

**Clause.** 1.5, question 1

**How to answer.** Reply in this thread, or open a comment with the form, giving the clause, the change proposed and the reason. Each comment is logged with a number and the date received. Comments are published on this page with the commenter's permission. Every comment receives a written disposition: accepted, accepted in part, or declined with the reason. The disposition table is published with the final text of Version 1.0. The comment period is open through October 31, 2026. Canonical text: https://gatewellgroup.com/protocol/v1.0/
